description.zh: 集群ID。
description.en: The cluster ID.

description.zh:
计算节点对应的ECS实例是否开启超线程。

> 该配置仅对部分支持开关超线程的实例规格生效。对于不支持的实例，默认开启超线程。具体请参见[自定义CPU选项](~~145895~~)。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable hyper-threading for the ECS instance that is used as the compute node.

>  You can only disable hyper-threading for some instance types. The hyper-threading is enabled for ECS instances by default. For more information, see [Specify and view CPU options](~~145895~~).

description.zh: DNS配置信息。
description.en: The configurations of DNS.

description.zh:
是否开启自动扩容。取值范围：
- true：开启自动扩容
- false：不开启自动扩容

默认值： false
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto scale-out. Valid values:

*   true: enables auto scale-out.
*   false: disables auto scale-out.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
是否开启自动缩容。取值范围：
- true：开启自动缩容
- false：不开启自动缩容

默认值： false
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto scale-in. Valid values:

*   true: enables auto scale-in.
*   false: disables auto scale-in.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
例外节点列表，不参与自动伸缩的节点列表。节点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

如果您希望一直保留某个节点，可以设置为例外节点，空闲时不被释放。
description.en:
The compute nodes that are excluded from auto scaling tasks. Separate multiple compute nodes with commas (,).

If you want to retain a compute node, you can specify the node as an additional node to retain the node when it is idle.

description.zh:
额外节点百分比。取值范围：0~100

默认值：0

如果作业负载需要新增100个计算节点，ExtraNodesGrowRatio值为2，那么最终新增数量为102。
description.en:
The percentage of extra compute nodes. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0.

If you need to add 100 compute nodes and the value of the ExtraNodesGrowRatio parameter is 2, 102 compute nodes are added.

description.zh:
每轮计算节点扩容的时间间隔。单位：分钟

取值范围：2~10

默认值：2

>一次扩容任务可能会分几次完成，或者连续触发扩容时的时间间隔。
description.en:
The interval between two consecutive rounds of scale-out. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2.

> An interval may exist during multiple rounds of a scale-out task or between two consecutive scale-out tasks.

description.zh:
扩容比例。取值范围：1~100

默认值：100

如果作业负载需要新增10个计算节点，GrowRatio配置为50，那么会进行多轮扩容，每轮扩容当前所需的50%节点。
description.en:
The percentage of each round of a scale-out task. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 100.

If you set GrowRatio to 50, the scale-out has two rounds. Each round completes half of the scale-out.

description.zh:
扩容超时时间。单位：分钟

取值范围：10~60

默认值：20

如果扩容时间大于扩容超时时间，节点依然未达到运行状态，该节点将被释放。
description.en:
The scale-out timeout period. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 10 to 60.

Default value: 20.

If the scale-out timeout period has been reached but the scale-out nodes still do not reach the Running state, the system releases them.

description.zh:
镜像ID。

> - 如果同时设置了`Queues.N.QueueImageId`和`ImageId`时，默认使用`Queues.N.QueueImageId`。
- 如果设置了`Queues.N.QueueImageId`或`ImageId`，以设置的参数为准。
- 如果`Queues.N.QueueImageId`和`ImageId`都为空，则默认使用集群上次扩容的镜像，若之前没有进行过扩容，则默认使用创建集群时的镜像。
description.en:
The IDs of the images.

> 

*   If both `Queues.N.QueueImageId` and `ImageId` are specified, `Queues.N.QueueImageId` prevails.

*   If you set `Queues.N.QueueImageId` or `ImageId`, the parameter that you set takes effect.
*   If you leave both `Queues.N.QueueImageId` and `ImageId` empty, the image that was specified when you created the cluster or the last time you scaled out the cluster is used by default.

description.zh:
集群最多可以扩容的计算节点数量。取值范围：0~500

默认值：100
description.en:
The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added to the cluster. Valid values: 0 to 500.

Default value: 100.

description.zh: 队列信息。
description.en: The information about the queue.

description.zh:
自动设置单轮扩容的最小节点数量。
如果设置为true，则每次扩容的最小节点数等于作业所需的节点数量，上限是99台。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically specify the minimum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of scale-out. If you set this parameter to true, the minimum number of nodes for each scale-out is equal to the number of nodes required by the job. The maximum number is 99.

description.zh: 随节点创建的数据盘信息列表。
description.en: The list of data disks.

description.zh:
队列是否允许自动扩容。取值范围：
- true：允许自动扩容
- false：不允许自动扩容

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether the queue enables auto scale-out. Valid values:

*   true: enables auto scale-out.
*   false: disables auto scale-out.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
队列是否允许自动缩容。取值范围：
- true：允许自动缩容
- false：不允许自动缩容

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether the queue enables auto scale-in. Valid values:

*   true: enables auto scale-in.
*   false: disables auto scale-in.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
队列中扩容的主机名前缀。方便您管理具有指定前缀的节点。

N的取值范围：1~8
description.en:
The hostname prefix of the host that is used to perform scale-out for the queue. You can manage compute nodes that have a specified hostname prefix.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

description.zh:
队列中扩容的主机名后缀。方便您管理具有指定后缀的节点。

N的取值范围：1~8
description.en:
The hostname suffix of the host that is used to perform scale-out for the queue. You can manage nodes that have a specified hostname suffix.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

description.zh: 队列中自动扩容的节点规格。N的取值范围：1~8
description.en: The instance type of the compute nodes that are automatically added to the queue. Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

description.zh: 队列中节点信息。
description.en: The instance types of the nodes in the queue.

description.zh:
队列允许扩容的最大节点数。取值范围：0~500

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：100
description.en:
The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added to the queue. Valid values: 0 to 500.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: 100.

description.zh:
自动伸缩每轮扩容的最大计算节点数。取值范围：0~99。

默认值：0。
description.en:
The maximum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of scale-out. Valid values: 0 to 99.

Default value: 0.

description.zh:
队列允许收缩的最小节点数。取值范围：0~50

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：0
description.en:
The minimum number of compute nodes that can be removed from the queue. Valid values: 0 to 50.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: 0.

description.zh:
自动伸缩每轮扩容的最小计算节点数。取值范围：1~99。

默认值：1。

如果某一轮次需扩容节点数量小于所设置的最小计算节点数，自动伸缩为保证资源的正常交付，会将该轮次的最小计算节点数自动调整为当前轮次需要扩容节点数量。

>该调整仅对当前轮次的最小计算节点数生效。
description.en:
The minimum number of compute nodes that can be added in each round of scale-out. Valid values: 1 to 99

Default value: 1.

If the number of compute nodes that you want to add in a round is less than the value of this property, the system automatically changes the value of this property to the number of compute nodes that you want to add in a round. This helps ensure that compute nodes can be added as expected.

>  The configuration takes effect only for the minimum compute nodes that can be added in the current round.

description.zh:
扩容队列的镜像ID。N的取值范围：1~8

> - 如果同时设置了`Queues.N.QueueImageId`和`ImageId`时，默认使用`Queues.N.QueueImageId`。
- 如果设置了`Queues.N.QueueImageId`或`ImageId`，以设置的参数为准。
- 如果`Queues.N.QueueImageId`和`ImageId`都为空，则默认使用集群上次扩容的镜像，若之前没有进行过扩容，则默认使用创建集群时的镜像。
description.en:
The image ID of the queue where the scale-out is performed. Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

> 

*   If you set both `Queues.N.QueueImageId` and `ImageId`, `Queues.N.QueueImageId` prevails.

*   If you set `Queues.N.QueueImageId` or `ImageId`, the parameter that you set takes effect.
*   If you leave both `Queues.N.QueueImageId` and `ImageId` empty, the image that was specified when you created the cluster or the last time when you scaled out the cluster is used by default.

description.zh: 队列名称。支持同时设置N个队列的名称，N的取值范围：1~8
description.en: The name of the queue. You can specify 1 to 8 names.

description.zh:
实例是否支持乱序排列，取值范围：

- true：是

- false：否

> 如果设置为true，自动伸缩会按照实例库存数量从多到少的顺序选择实例规格，尽力交付实例资源。
description.en:
Specifies whether the instances are unordered. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

>  If you set this parameter to true, the system selects instance types in descending order of the number of instances in stock during auto scaling.

description.zh:
队列中自动扩容的计算节点的每小时最高价格，支持最多3位小数。参数`Queues.N.SpotStrategy`取值为`SpotWithPriceLimit`时生效。

N的取值范围：1~8
description.en:
The maximum hourly price of the compute nodes that are automatically added to the queue. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. The parameter takes effect only when `Queues.N.SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

description.zh:
队列中自动扩容的计算节点的抢占策略。N的取值范围：1~8

抢占策略取值范围为：
- NoSpot：正常按量付费节点。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式节点。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式节点。

默认值：NoSpot
description.en:
The preemption policy of the compute node that is automatically added to the queue. Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Valid values:

*   NoSpot: The compute node is created as a pay-as-you-go instance.
*   SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute node is created as a preemptible instance that has a user-defined maximum hourly price.
*   SpotAsPriceGo: The compute node is created as a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is used as the bid price.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh:
队列中扩容的计算节点系统盘类型。取值范围：

- cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
- cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
- cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
- cloud：普通云盘，已售罄

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：cloud_efficiency
description.en:
The category of the system disk specified for the compute nodes that are added to the queue. Valid values:

*   cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
*   cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
*   cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD).
*   cloud: basic disk. Disks of this type are retired.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: cloud_efficiency.

description.zh:
队列中扩容的计算节点系统盘性能等级。取值范围：

- PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
- PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
- PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
- PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：PL1
description.en:
The performance level of the system disk specified for the compute nodes that are added to the queue. Valid values:

*   PL0: An ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
*   PL1: An ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
*   PL2: An ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
*   PL3: An ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: PL1.

description.zh:
队列中扩容的节点系统盘大小。单位：GB

取值范围：40~500

N的取值范围：1~8

默认值：40
description.en:
The size of the system disk specified for the compute nodes that are added to the queue. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Valid values of N: 1 to 8.

Default value: 40.

description.zh:
节点连续空闲（未运行作业）次数。节点收缩检查时，一个节点连续处于空闲状态的次数。

取值范围：2~5

默认值：3

如果设置为3，表示一个计算节点连续空闲超过3次，就会被释放。因为ShrinkIntervalInMinutes默认值是2分钟，所以默认配置下，一个计算节点连续空闲时间超过6分钟，就会被释放。
description.en:
The number of consecutive times that a compute node is idle during the resource scale-in check.

Valid values: 2 to 5.

Default value: 3.

If the parameter is set to 3, a compute node is idle more than three consecutive times. In this case, the node is released. If a compute node is idle for longer than 6 minutes continuously, it is released by default. This is because the default value of the ShrinkIntervalInMinutes parameter is 2.

description.zh:
每轮计算节点收缩的时间间隔。单位：分钟

取值范围：2~10

默认值：2
description.en:
The interval between two consecutive rounds of scale-in. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 2.

description.zh: 设置节点的每小时最高价格，最多支持3位小数。参数`SpotStrategy`取值为`SpotWithPriceLimit`时生效。
description.en: The maximum hourly price of the compute nodes. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. The parameter takes effect only when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`.

description.zh:
计算节点抢占策略。取值范围：
- NoSpot：正常按量付费节点。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式节点。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式节点。

默认值：NoSpot
description.en:
The preemption policy of the compute nodes. Valid values:

*   NoSpot: The compute nodes are pay-as-you-go instances.
*   SpotWithPriceLimit: The compute nodes are preemptible instances that have a user-defined maximum hourly price.
*   SpotAsPriceGo: The compute nodes are preemptible instances for which the market price at the time of purchase is used as the bid price.

Default value: NoSpot.

title.zh: 设置自动伸缩配置信息

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

当队列配置和全局配置中配置不一致时，以队列设置为优先。
descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

If the settings in the Queue Configuration section are different from the settings in the Global Configurations section, the former prevails.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc set-auto-scale-config --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --enable-auto-grow false --enable-auto-shrink false --grow-interval-in-minutes 2 --shrink-interval-in-minutes 2 --shrink-idle-times 3 --grow-timeout-in-minutes 20 --extra-nodes-grow-ratio 0 --grow-ratio 50 --max-nodes-in-cluster 100 --exclude-nodes i-bp19lgqwxb4206t50000,i-bp1g4hvzs9pywrhb0000 --spot-strategy SpotWithPriceLimit --spot-price-limit 0.062 --image-id centos_7_03_64_20G_alibase_2017080000 --queues '[{"HostNameSuffix":"000","MinNodesInQueue":0,"MaxNodesInQueue":30,"SortedByInventory":false,"EnableAutoGrow":false,"DataDisks":[{"DataDiskPerformanceLevel":"PL1","DataDiskKMSKeyId":"0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fb40826X","DataDiskDeleteWithInstance":true,"DataDiskEncrypted":false,"DataDiskSize":40,"DataDiskCategory":"cloud_efficiency"}],"QueueImageId":"centos_7_03_64_20G_alibase_2017080000","SystemDiskSize":40,"SystemDiskLevel":"PL1","MinNodesPerCycle":5,"MaxNodesPerCycle":20,"EnableAutoShrink":false,"SystemDiskCategory":"cloud_efficiency","AutoMinNodesPerCycle":false,"HostNamePrefix":"compute","SpotPriceLimit":0.662,"InstanceTypes":[{"SpotInterruptionBehavior":"Terminate","ZoneId":"cn-hangzhou-b","VSwitchId":"vsw-bp1lfcjbfb099rrjn0000","SpotPriceLimit":0.66,"SpotDuration":0,"InstanceType":"ecs.n1.tiny","SpotStrategy":"SpotWithPriceLimit"}],"InstanceType":"ecs.n1.medium","QueueName":"cluster1","SpotStrategy":"NoSpot"}]' --compute-enable-ht true --dns-config DnsType_:_PrivateZone_,_DnsName_:_xxxxx --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc SetAutoScaleConfig --region cn-hangzhou --ComputeEnableHt true --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.SpotDuration 0 --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskKMSKeyId '0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fb40826X' --ShrinkIdleTimes 3 --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.InstanceType 'ecs.n1.tiny' --EnableAutoShrink false --GrowRatio 50 --Queues.1.EnableAutoGrow false --GrowIntervalInMinutes 2 --Queues.1.MinNodesInQueue 0 --Queues.1.MaxNodesInQueue 30 --GrowTimeoutInMinutes 20 --DnsConfig 'DnsType_:_PrivateZone_,_DnsName_:_xxxxx' --Queues.1.SortedByInventory false --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskSize 40 --Queues.1.HostNamePrefix compute --ImageId centos_7_03_64_20G_alibase_2017080000 --SpotPriceLimit '0.062' --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ExcludeNodes 'i-bp19lgqwxb4206t50000,i-bp1g4hvzs9pywrhb0000' --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1lfcjbfb099rrjn0000' --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskCategory cloud_efficiency --Queues.1.EnableAutoShrink false --SpotStrategy SpotWithPriceLimit --ExtraNodesGrowRatio 0 --EnableAutoGrow false --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --Queues.1.AutoMinNodesPerCycle false --MaxNodesInCluster 100 --Queues.1.MinNodesPerCycle 5 --Queues.1.SystemDiskCategory cloud_efficiency --Queues.1.HostNameSuffix 000 --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.SpotStrategy SpotWithPriceLimit --Queues.1.SystemDiskLevel PL1 --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.SpotPriceLimit '0.66' --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskPerformanceLevel PL1 --Queues.1.SpotPriceLimit '0.662' --Queues.1.SystemDiskSize 40 --Queues.1.QueueName cluster1 --Queues.1.InstanceType 'ecs.n1.medium' --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskEncrypted false --Queues.1.DataDisks.1.DataDiskDeleteWithInstance true --Queues.1.QueueImageId centos_7_03_64_20G_alibase_2017080000 --Queues.1.MaxNodesPerCycle 20 --ShrinkIntervalInMinutes 2 --Queues.1.InstanceTypes.1.SpotInterruptionBehavior Terminate --Queues.1.SpotStrategy NoSpot
